An original lucky merchant cat, a living orange-and-ivory longhair rather than a ceramic figurine. It sits upright with a broad plume tail curling around its paws; one front paw is raised in a small inviting gesture and the other rests lightly on a single old copper coin. Amber eyes, short whiskers, a narrow white blaze and a confident half-smile give it a clever shopkeeper personality. A dark red braided collar holds a small patinated bronze bell and a tiny jade bead. Its coat has layered warm stripes, a soft cream chest ruff and believable feline proportions. The coin is a quiet accessory, never larger than the paw.

Original high-quality painterly character concept for a fantasy card-game companion selection screen. Rich, memorable design with coherent anatomy, tactile materials and a readable silhouette at small display size.

Plain matte warm-gray background with only a faint contact shadow, no landscape, frame, lettering or other characters.

Burnt orange, ivory, red cord, copper and jade; warm side lighting, large plush fur masses with selected fine whiskers and subtle scratched metal.
